leakage_verdict: No measurable leakage from same-tournament history — AUC identical with and without it.

axis_weight_analysis.method: OLS + LogisticRegression + RandomForest on axis composite scores, time-split 2019
axis_weight_analysis.r2_note: R² of 0.10–0.15 is normal for match-level sports prediction; low R² reflects genuine randomness, not model failure.

breakPressure.note: Overweighted — BP conversion low-signal in this dataset

pressure.note: Overweighted — clutch metrics sparse; low predictive signal

durability.note: Near zero empirical signal — grass matches are short

axis_weight_analysis.interpretation: The declared weights are qualitatively correct in ordering serveReturn first. However the regression evidence suggests breakPressure and pressure are given more weight than the data supports, and rallyShape (grass-specific win rate) is the second most predictive axis. The fingerprint-based axes (SPCI, clutch) carry meaning not captured in the simple delta-feature proxy — treat the suggested weights as a benchmark, not a prescription.
axis_weight_analysis.curated_backtest: 6/6 directional predictions correct across 6 historical matchups

notes: Time-based split (train ≤2018, test ≥2019). Features are pre-match only (no leakage). All three models outperform ranking-only baseline (~63%). Brier score confirms well-calibrated probabilities.

mc_fingerprint_backtest.method: Phased point simulation (v6) — prior-edition fingerprints predict each match
mc_fingerprint_backtest.engine_version: v6 (Phase A Elo: year-aware snapshots + all-surface Elo training)
mc_fingerprint_backtest.leakage_note: Fingerprints built from editions BEFORE the predicted year. Career window (last 3 editions) never includes the test year.
mc_fingerprint_backtest.notes: Coverage ~50–70% per year — first-time Wimbledon players have no prior fingerprint and are excluded. These tend to be lower-seeded players, so excluded matches are systematically easier to predict, meaning true accuracy on uncovered matches may be lower.

changelog.v6: Phase A Elo fix: all-surface ATP match training (108k matches) + year-aware snapshots — correctness gain, accuracy ties v5 at 68.1% (gains and losses cancel year-to-year)

mc_fingerprint_backtest_aggregate_baseli.method: Aggregate Markov-style engine — pre-v3 production baseline
mc_fingerprint_backtest_aggregate_baseli.note: Reference baseline; v3 phased model surpasses it on accuracy and Brier.
